what: Press the vertical pill tab stuck at the bottom right of the screen (88×240, a shape with only one corner less rounded) and a 700px panel slides out from beyond the right edge with .4s ease-in-out. The tab turns into a flat ear attached to the panel’s left edge (a light panel rounded only on the left) and the background is covered with 30% dark ink. It closes by pressing again, the scrim, the close button, a link inside the panel, or Esc. On phone the tab becomes a wide pill at the bottom center of the screen and the panel appears in place — a guide drawer: ”Is the information you’re looking for here?”

options.--fx-tab-x: Distance the closed tab sticks out from the panel’s left edge (via style), default -100px

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .rr-sup (the “Is the info you’re looking for here?” tab on every page — original all_m_support: on _show the inner goes translateX(100%)→0 .4s ease-in-out, tab left -100→-88px, backdrop behind)
